title: Doc overclaim on _silent_drop(): CON requests produce empty ACK; only NON requests are truly wire-silent
description: Codereview edge-pass finding on b7z9.121.3: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py docstring claims 'the requesting side discards' / 'nothing crosses the wire', but aiocoap encodes the no_response suppression server-side and for CON requests substitutes an empty ACK (messagemanager.py:444-450 && 461). Only NON (e.g. ff02::1 multicast) requests are truly wire-silent. Fix: rewrite comment to accurately describe aiocoap behavior.
